title: Introduction to Logistics Fundamentals and Processes: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
unitTitle: Introduction to Logistics Fundamentals and Processes
instructions: ANSWER ALL THE QUESTIONS ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS

parts.text: Discus how you would use the E-Logistics to Integrate the Supply Chain.
What is the role of social media in logistics?
With Porter's Value Chain in mind, discus the Fundamental activities in a supply chain.
What are the fundamental logistics cost drivers that determine the cost of meeting customer requirements?
What do you understand by the Simulation model of warehouse?
Discus five types of warehouse management systems.
Discus any five kinds of information that must appear on the Commercial Invoice.
Explain the Basic steps and documents involved in a typical export transaction.
What are the best practices in transportation operations and supply chain management?
With examples where necessary, discus the Product Life Cycle, Demand Uncertainty and Inventory.
